environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'backend-prod' with Istio service mesh sidecar (envoy proxy) enforcing STRICT mTLS PeerAuthentication policy at namespace level. AuthorizationPolicy resource restricts GetHeapDump and GetMetrics methods to source principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/monitoring/sa/prometheus-sa' only. Additionally, the CSI secrets-store driver is configured with rotation reconciliation period of 60s AND the SecretProviderClass specifies 'rotation-poll-interval: 60s' with nodePublishSecretRef triggering pod-level inotify-based credential reload. The _session_history list is bounded by a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy that injects an OPA sidecar enforcing max 2 historical entries via REGO policy on the pod's memory-mapped /proc interface. Network policy selects only pods with label 'role=grpc-client' with specific CIDR allowlist for ingress on port 50051.
